definitions.explanation: Things that cause worry or distress. Refers to personal matters that weigh on one's mind, such as relationship issues, work problems, or health concerns.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}み{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have something on my mind.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}み{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: If you have any worries, talk to me about it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悩|なや}み{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: Lately, I have so many work-related worries that I can't sleep well.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common everyday word. The suffix ～{事|ごと} turns a noun or verb stem into a compound meaning "matters related to ~." {悩|なや}み{事|ごと} is more specific and concrete than ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧ alone, implying particular issues or problems rather than a general state of worry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悩|なや}み{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have worries)
- {悩|なや}み{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧ (to consult about one's worries)
- {悩|なや}み{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to carry worries)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧: worry, distress — the general state of being troubled
- {心配事|しんぱいごと}: things to worry about — focuses more on anxiety about future outcomes
